description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'EditorPanel' that manages note editing functionality, including saving, deleting, regenerating summaries, and UI rendering.

classes.name: EditorPanel
classes.description: A LightningJS component for editing notes with functionalities like save, delete, and summarization.

methods.name: _syncFromStore
methods.description: Synchronizes component state with the currently selected note from the store.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current title and content to the selected note in the store.

methods.name: regenerateSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary from the current content using the summarize utility.

methods.name: clearOrNew
methods.description: Clears the current fields or adds a new blank note.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected note from the store.
